answer: An agent may attest only after three independent notaries, each bound to a different island, countersign its enrollment and lock 150 POA of saffron collateral for four epochs. Each notary must answer a raven challenge, a one-time VRF prompt, within twelve minutes, or its collateral is slashed and the enrollment is void. If any two notaries share a funding graph, all three collateral locks burn and those keys are banned for twenty epochs. A new alias therefore needs three already-aged, separately funded notaries, so mass-minted names cannot buy a cheap majority.
